text:
The food was as to be expected however the restaurant stank strongly of urine, so much so that one of the workers was walking around spraying air freshener, so I don't know which was worse, the pee stink or the smell of summer flowers.
There was a serious problem with the gents lavatory, customers were backing right out due to the smell.
In hindsight I deeply regretted staying because I smelt it as soon as I walked in, I should have turned around and walked out immediately.
The management should have shut down the restaurant and provided a deep clean to eradicate the urine smell, it was unacceptable to expect customers to eat in those conditions, all the customers in my vicinity were covering their noses due to the smell of urine and the air freshener that was being sprayed around while we were EATING!
Gross McDonald's, shame on you :-(
author: J-Rocks!

text:
** 329 Washington St, Boston, MA 02108 **

My order was a cheeseburger plain (that is, bread, meat and cheese) and I paid 0.10 for the paper bag (which I already think is absurd, but I never hesitated).
The guy who was doing EXPO (serving the lunch) gave me a burger with bread + meat and placed my order on the table, without the paper bag...
I complained to him that the sandwich came without cheese. He rudely countered by informing me that I ordered "plain".
I said: That's right! Bread, meat and cheese. Because if I wanted bread and meat, I would have paid cheaper and ordered a hamburger...
He rolled his eyes and came back with a raw cheese in his hand and gave it to me!
Lack of respect for the customer and empathy for human beings...
author: Gab Costa

text: This is by far the worst McDonald's not one person working there speaks English so they can't even understand you or take your order I come into this McDonald's every single day and every single day they get my coffee order wrong how hard is it to make two large caramel iced coffees with 12 caramel and four equal I don't see how hard that is but I guess it is so I told them that they did not put 12 caramel in my coffee so instead of making my coffee right they hand me a cup with a drop of caramel in it when I tell you what drop of caramel it was literally one pump of caramel in a cup they wouldn't refund me my money and they wouldn't make my coffee's over again I will never come to this McDonald's ever again

text: I walked to McDonald's and went to the machine to order my food. I rushed to order nuggets and fries . The machine gave me many options but not the option I was looking for which was fries and nuggets. So I decided to stop wasting time with the machine and rush to the counter and order there. I met the cashier nice guy and he took my order. I received my order within minutes. 2 minutes to be exact which was excellent in my mind. But the minute I got to my job and took a bite after 10 minutes, I notice the chicken was not heated much at all. The fries were stale and super salty. And the overall feeling of the food made me disgusted. I decided from then on to never order from there again.
author: Alain Lafume
